title: Full AI agency with 147 sub-agents in 12 departments for everyone #openai #aiagency #aitech
description:
An open-source AI agency was launched as a GitHub repository featuring 147 specialized sub-agents structured like a real company. Organized into 12 departments such as engineering, marketing, sales, support, finance, and security, each agent operates with a distinct role, personality, and tone to perform tasks efficiently.

This AI agency streamlines complex workflows by running all agents in parallel upon integration with cloud platforms like Code, Cursor, or Codex, automating tasks from bug fixes to ad copy generation. It demonstrates a scalable, modular approach to AI-driven business automation, reflecting a shift toward decentralized and highly customizable AI workforces.

The availability of such a tool supports innovation in AI collaboration, reducing barriers and enabling businesses and developers to deploy sophisticated AI teams without large investments. This approach can accelerate productivity, enhance multi-disciplinary project management, and drive forward AI adoption across industries.
